notes: Playing as a named dog in a forest with hunger and thirst meters is the Animal Sim subgenre — Wolves' Life territory — so Roleplay & Avatar Sim leads on wilderness-open, a natural biome with no settlement at all, which is also the cheapest shape available. It was a close call against Survival, named second for the food-and-water resource loop, but the author's answer that nothing hunts the Laika removes the threat that Survival's whole option table is built around, so leading with it would have imported hazards and hiding cover this game does not have. The lakes, rivers and ponds are an explicit request and land on water-body, whose CHECK should clear immediately since the dog drinks from the bank rather than swimming. With no user to ask I read the hares and squirrels as huntable ambient wildlife on npc-population rather than hostile spawners, added a den as the dog's rest point and home anchor since an endless survival loop has no other place to return to, and kept a focal landmark so a few minutes of realistic forest stays navigable.
